hook: Phosphorus-doped silicon nanoantennas detect 1.55 micrometer light, all in silicon at room temperature.
summary: Patterning heavily phosphorus-doped silicon into nanoantenna arrays shifts its plasmonic resonances into the 1 to 2 micrometer range. Detectors built from them respond at 1.55 micrometers. The responsivity comes from plasmon-enhanced absorption plus trap-assisted gain under bias, so it does not reflect the intrinsic quantum efficiency.
title: Near-infrared plasmonic response in hyperdoped silicon nanoantennas for all-silicon photodetection
